objects.description: [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) has added the Registry key `HKLM\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Control\Print\Environments\Windows x64\Print Processors\UDPrint” /v Driver /d “spool.dll /f` to load malware as a Print Processor.(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022)
objects.description_fa: [Earth Lusca](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1006) کلید رجیستری «HKLM\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Control\Print\Environments\Windows x64\Print Processors\UDPrint» /v Driver /d «malware /f'spool to Print» را اضافه کرده است. پردازنده.(Citation: TrendMicro EarthLusca 2022)
